messages:
maya: FYI customer AcmeApp reporting intermittent 5xx from /v1/generate since ~14:02 UTC. They see 502/504 and timeouts. Said it started after a burst of traffic. Logs attached in their ticket. :alarm_clock:

maya: sample curl they sent: 
```\ncurl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"hello"}'\n```
response: 502 Bad Gateway (html body).

jordan: Acknowledged, I'll grab recent error rates and the control-plane traces. Do we know if it's auth failures or routing?

maya: Customer noted auth errors briefly (401) then the 5xx spike. Support captured a stack where gateway returned 502 from control-plane upstream.

ops-bot: ALERT: control-plane.routing-policy HTTP 5xx rate > 15% (5m avg) at 14:04 UTC :fire:

simon: pulling traces. early look: routing-policy svc shows lots of `GetPolicy(customer_id)` calls timing out to config-db replicas. Retries cascade into session/auth layer causing 502s at the gateway.

chitra: configdb metrics look noisy, primary read latency p95=1.1s, p99=3.9s, connection saturation on config-db cluster. I see a spiky increase in connections from control-plane pool at 14:01 UTC.

ryan: any recent deploys for routing-policy or config-db?

jordan: no routing-policy deploys until yesterday. config-db had a minor restart on one replica at 13:50 UTC (maintenance), but it was healthy afterward according to Helm. Could be insufficient pool size after restart.

chitra: reproducer against admin endpoint: 
```\n# timed query to policy store (internal)\ncurl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer internal-token" \
  "https://controlplane.internal/route?customer_id=acme" -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\\n' -o /dev/null\n# returns: 504 3.87\n```

simon: stack trace from routing-policy logs (sanitized): 
```\n2026-03-14T14:03:12Z ERROR handler.go:87 GetPolicy timeout after 2s -> sql: db busy -> upstream timeout -> 504\n2026-03-14T14:03:13Z WARN router.go:45 fallback policy not found -> returning 502 to gateway\n```

maya: Customer wants ETA and mitigation, they're seeing app-level errors and some retries causing user impact.

jordan: Mitigation suggestions: 1) increase config-db conn pool for control-plane (temp), 2) scale routing-policy horizontally (add 2 replicas), 3) add circuit-breaker to return cached policy quickly, 4) set default fallback policy so gateway doesn't 502.

chitra: I can bump the DB pool limit for the control-plane service and spin up 2 routing-policy replicas now. Doing pool bump to 200 connections for the control-plane pool. Rolling now.

ops-bot: ACTION: rolling restart job queued for controlplane-routing-policy x2 replicas (initiated by chitra)

simon: while you're doing that, I'll patch the routing-policy to prefer local cache on DB timeout: quick PR to change behavior to return cached policy with warning instead of error. Will apply as hotfix.

ryan: Also adding an emergency fallback policy to admin store so requests have a default route. Admin API: 
```\nPOST /admin/default-routing {"policy":"default-fallback"}\n```
Done.

jordan: Support message draft to AcmeApp: 
"Hey — we're seeing a transient control-plane dependency outage (routing-policy -> config DB) causing 502/504s for some requests. Engineering is applying pool + replica scaling and a cache fallback. You should see reduced errors within ~10-15 minutes. We're monitoring and will follow up with a root cause summary."

maya: Sent to customer. They replied: "thanks, errors dropped after ~10m but we saw a couple of user-facing failures — please confirm root cause and long-term fix." :thumbsup:

chitra: scaling finished, DB pool increase rolled, routing-policy replicas healthy. p99 latency back to 120ms, 5xx rate down to 0.6%.

ops-bot: RESOLVED ALERT: control-plane.routing-policy 5xx rate normalized at 14:18 UTC :white_check_mark:

simon: Patch applied to return cached policy on DB timeout. Will open follow-up PR to improve metrics and add circuit-breaker with backoff and separate DB pool for burst traffic.

jordan: Will create an incident ticket and link logs/traces for RCA. Proposed RCA: maintenance restart + insufficient pool sizing caused connection saturation -> routing-policy DB timeouts -> retries cascaded -> gateway 502s. Long-term: add read-replicas, increase pool headroom during maintenance windows, cached fallback, and a small playbook.

maya: Customer happy with the temporary fix and asked for postmortem. I told them we'll share RCA and remediation timeline.

ryan: I'll schedule a follow-up postmortem sync with SRE + DB + Routing owners tomorrow.

maya: thanks everyone. I'll mark the support ticket as awaiting postmortem.

chitra: one more notes: disable aggressive retry from gateway for now (backoff to 200-500ms) to avoid thundering herd during DB hiccups. I'll open the config change.

simon: agree. Also adding an alert to notify when config-db connection count > 85% of pool.

maya: closing thread here, will add postmortem link when ready.
